items.title: PNC Financial Services Group (PNC) In OCC Report On De Banking By Belief
items.summary: PNC Financial Services Group (NYSE:PNC) was cited in a new OCC report for policies tied to account closures over belief-based affiliations. The regulator found PNC Bank applied reputation risk reviews that contributed to de-banking groups with specific political or religious identities. The Trump Administration responded by pledging federal action to curb what it calls the weaponization of finance in such cases.
